event.description: Share only the value map across two attention heads
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 14 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020 at 3,168 parameters/99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0123, whose query-shared candidate scored 0.00% at 1,593 parameters. Hypothesis: both query and key maps require head-specific routing geometry, but the content feature map can be common because different attention weights still produce distinct head outputs. Preserve all 32 Q/K rows, replace the two value maps by their checkpoint-average 8x16 map broadcast across heads, and share across depth, yielding 1,593 parameters. This is more informative than full multi-query attention because attempts 0122-0123 already bound Q/K sharing and this exact complement isolates value-head diversity at the same parameter count. Causal softmax and generic autoregressive decoding remain unchanged.
